fact: The government says work begun on 5 May 2026 under the Gabon Digital programme aims to modernise the cadastre and structure land data, and a 14 September 2026 session with SNEDAI continued it on digitalising land tenure.
The digital economy minister said on 30 November 2025 that the digitalisation of cadastral processes is under way, and called for a digital cadastre attesting ownership through an accessible map.

Gabon's Housing, Habitat, Urbanism and Cadastre minister and the Digital Economy minister met on accelerating the digitalisation of the cadastre and land procedures, reviewing advances including deployment of the 'Ogooué' application and online case-tracking, per the Agence Gabonaise de Presse.
